title: Modern 30A
meta_description: Welcome to Modern 30A, a stunning 5BDR coastal escape with a rooftop deck, ocean views and community pool.
description_expanded:
Wake up to shimmering Gulf views and the slow, peaceful rhythm of 30A at Modern 30A, a coastal retreat designed for groups who crave both style and connection. Set in one of Santa Rosa Beach's most coveted stretches---moments from sugar-white sands, scenic bike paths, and the vibrant dining of Gulf Place---this multi-level home blends modern comfort with the kind of indoor-outdoor living that makes every day feel like a vacation.

Spread across four thoughtfully designed floors, the home invites your group to gather, unwind, and make memories with ease. The open-concept main level is bright and breezy, anchored by a chef's kitchen with stainless-steel appliances, a cozy living room with an oversized TV, and a dining table perfect for casual breakfasts or late-night conversations. Slide open the doors to step onto one of two private balconies, where you can sip your morning coffee with sea air drifting by.

When you want to elevate the moment---literally---head to the expansive rooftop. This is the showstopper: a loungey outdoor living space with seating for six, a grill for easy dinners, a dining table for sunset meals, and uninterrupted views stretching toward the Gulf. It's the kind of setting that becomes the backdrop for your group's favorite memories.

Bedrooms are spread across three floors for maximum privacy, each one designed with plush bedding and calm, coastal tones. Five bedrooms feature king beds with ensuite bathrooms, while the first floor offers a queen bedroom and a bonus den with a queen sleeper---ideal for flexible group setups. With five full baths and two half baths, no one ever waits.

Entertainment comes easy here: a dedicated game room for friendly competition, two laundry sets for long stays, and access to a community pool when you're not relaxing at the beach.

Modern 30A is polished, airy, and designed for togetherness---yet it grants every guest space to retreat. Whether you're watching the sun dip into the Gulf from the rooftop or spending a lazy afternoon by the pool, this home captures the essence of the Emerald Coast: bright, breezy, and unforgettable.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Hub 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Laguna Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note a pack-n-play is available during your stay.
- The elevator is not available for guest use.

Parking Details:
- 2 parking spots available in the carport, plus 1 overflow spot available if needed.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
